name: Martial Cottle Park SRA
description: Martial Cottle Park is a state recreation area in south San Jose operated by Santa Clara County Parks. It celebrates the valley's farming history and highlights modern organic, sustainable, and urban farming.
fullDescription: Martial Cottle Park is a state recreation area in south San Jose operated by Santa Clara County Parks. It celebrates the valley's farming history and highlights modern organic, sustainable, and urban farming.
whatTheyOffer:
- Paved trails for walking, biking, and horseback riding
- Leashed dogs welcome
- Picnic areas, including reservable group picnic sites
- No camping
howToGetIt: Operated by Santa Clara County Parks. Vehicle day use is $6. State park passes are not listed as accepted here. Call the park office at 408-535-4060 for hours and group picnic reservations.
keywords: Martial Cottle Park, San Jose, Santa Clara County, agricultural history, hiking, urban farm, free
